identity.title: Protostellar Outflows at the EarliesT Stages (POETS): IX. Magnetohydrodynamic disk winds traced by SO and SO<SUB>2</SUB> in luminous protostars

paper_type_evidence.quote: We employed IRAM Northern Extended Millimeter Array and archival Atacama Large Millimeter Array observations of IRAS 21078$+$5211 and G035.02$+$0.35, respectively

question.value: Do the SO and SO2 emissions at 100-1000 au in two luminous YSOs trace magneto-centrifugally launched MHD disk winds, as inferred from water masers at 10-100 au, rather than X-winds?

evidence.quote: The goal of this article is to further test the water maser MHD DW predictions focusing on the YSOs IRAS 21078$+$5211 and G035.02$+$0.35
was observed within the project 2016.1.01036.S (P.I.: P. Sanhueza) by ALMA in Cycle 4 on September 12, 2017

evidence.quote: for G035.02$+$0.35, ALMA Cycle 4 Band 6 archival observations are available.

evidence.quote: Four spectral windows (SPWs) that had a width of 1875 MHz centered at the sky frequency of 217.812, 220.013, 232.013, and 234.513 GHz were recorded.

findings_qualitative.value: In G035.02+0.35 only SO extends outside the disk; the other molecules are confined to the disk

evidence.quote: SO is the only molecular species whose emission extends well outside the disk.

claims.hypothesis: SO emission traces a rotating magneto-centrifugal wind in both YSOs
claims.experiment: Maps and PV plots of SO along and off the disk midplane
claims.result: Keplerian-like PV profiles, consistent at off-disk positions
claims.finding: SO traces a wind launched from the disk

evidence.quote: Our analysis shows that, in both YSOs, the spatial and velocity distributions of SO are consistent with a rotating wind magneto-centrifugally launched from the YSO disk.

claims.hypothesis: The transversal V_LSR gradient in IRAS 21078+5211 could be envelope rotation
claims.experiment: Centrifugal equilibrium estimate with observed gradient

evidence.quote: This value greatly exceeds the value of the YSO mass of 5.6$\pm$2 $M_{\odot}$

claims.hypothesis: The wind is an extended MHD DW rather than an X-wind
claims.experiment: Compare molecular distributions and excitation with shock models
claims.result: Radial molecular stratification in IRAS 21078; lack of other molecules in G035.02
claims.finding: Favors radially extended MHD DW over X-wind

evidence.quote: can be well explained in terms of a radially extended MHD DW, rather than a compact X-wind.

why_this_data.value: Two datasets overlap in frequency with comparable ≈250 au and ≈0.5 km/s resolutions, allowing a comparison

evidence.quote: provide comparable linear ($\approx$250 au at the target distance) and velocity ($\approx$0.5 km s$^{-1}$) resolutions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: X-wind with entrained ambient gas rejected because only SO traces the wind in G035.02+0.35

evidence.quote: That already rules out the possibility that we are observing ambient gas entrained in a fast wide-angle X-wind

limitations_admitted.value: Angular resolution insufficient to resolve disk vertical structure

evidence.quote: That is certainly due to insufficient angular resolution to resolve the disk structure vertically

limitations_admitted.value: SiO 5-4 resolved out at these scales

evidence.quote: the SiO 5–4 emission, another potential outflow tracer, is resolved out at these small scales
